deliverable_spec.card: 16:10, at least 1280x800, PNG; the subject must read at 220x138 px (the picker card size on a phone)
deliverable_spec.safe_area: keep the top-left third of heroes calm and darker (or plain paper on light themes): UI text sits there

global_style: Real photography, not a render: shot like a high-end editorial or luxury-watch campaign on a full-frame camera, shallow depth of field, true reflections, physically accurate materials (toned silver with micro-scratches, gold, brass, marble, walnut, velvet, glass), soft volumetric light, rich natural grading, fine film grain. Real-looking coins or bullion in a place that fits the mood. Calm, expensive, cinematic. Exception: an image whose `medium` names an illustration, pixel art, clay or poster style is made in that medium, at the same premium standard (clean, crafted, never cheap clip-art).
negative: no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no frame, no faces, no hands, no 3D-render plastic look in the photo images, no oversaturation, no HDR halos, no warped or melting coins, no invented legible inscriptions
coin_rule: Coins look like real circulated or uncirculated world coins (a generic portrait, eagle or crest is fine); never invent a legible inscription.

review_notes.obsidian: Every image must show three things together: (1) black volcanic glass, (2) a hammered GOLD sun with sharp pointed rays, set with carved GREEN jade, (3) one real silver coin at the sun's centre. An obsidian rock on its own is not this theme.
review_notes.lightwell: The coin on its small dark stone plinth, inside the blade of light, must be clearly visible at 220x138 px. The concrete room alone was not enough.

images.prompt: Studio product photograph, seen from slightly above: a large hammered GOLD sun disc with sixteen sharp pointed rays, its inner ring set with carved GREEN jadeite cabochons, lies on a polished black obsidian slab with glassy conchoidal ripples; in the exact centre of the sun one real circulated silver coin, sharp. Low warm raking light makes the gold glow and the jade translucent; the obsidian mirrors the gold. Gold, green and black must all be clearly visible.

Wider studio photograph of the same piece: a hammered GOLD sun disc with sharp pointed rays and a ring of carved GREEN jadeite, one real circulated silver coin at its centre, set into a polished black obsidian slab, placed in the right half of the frame; warm low light, deep black surroundings. Keep the top-left third calm and dark (UI text sits there).

A quiet board-formed concrete chapel in the style of Tadao Ando, framed closer: one blade of sunlight from a roof slot falls across the wall and lands squarely on a small dark stone plinth in the lower middle of the frame; on the plinth lies one real circulated silver coin, sharp and bright in the light; dust in the beam, deep soft shadows. The plinth and coin must be the clear subject.
